description: This file defines a React functional component 'StatCard' which renders an advanced statistical card UI element. The component supports displaying a title, main value, subtitle, icon, trend indicator, sparkline visualization, and loading state, with configurable variants for styling. It imports React, a Sparkline component, and theme CSS styles.

methods.name: StatCard
methods.description: React functional component that renders a statistical card with optional trend indicators, sparklines, icons, and loading state based on props.
